notes: Added two new categories (NICE and RCS) plus a new SDCEP emergency-care subject. NICE: wisdom-teeth-extraction (TA1, 2000). RCS: six subjects covering FDS-AMP gap-fill (acute-infections — pericoronitis/dry socket/periodontal abscess/necrotising periodontal; non-cardiac-prophylaxis — joint replacements/IV access/dialysis/immunocompromised; oral-fungal-and-viral — candidosis/primary herpetic gingivostomatitis), first-permanent-molar-extraction (RCS 2023), palatally-ectopic-canine (RCS 2022), and unerupted-maxillary-incisors (RCS 2022, OCR'd source). SDCEP emergency-care covers telephone triage and self-help advice from the 2007 SDCEP EDC guidance.
